change_summary: Extended LLM replay attribution with production-context alignment. `quant/backtester.py` now records backtest candidate tickers per covered date and `quant/llm_backlog.py` compares them against saved production `quant_signals_YYYYMMDD.json`, classifying covered days as `aligned`, `production_quant_empty`, `production_quant_missing`, or `production_quant_mismatch`. CLI now prints production-aligned coverage alongside raw candidate coverage, and regression coverage was added in `quant/test_quant.py`.

delta_metrics.note: Pure blocker-accuracy upgrade. Trading metrics stayed bit-identical on the deterministic snapshot, but the usable LLM sample shrank materially: raw candidate coverage still reads 4/31 days and 4/44 signals, while production-aligned coverage is only 1/31 days and 1/44 signals. Two of the four covered days (`20260416`, `20260421`) had saved production `quant_signals=[]`, and one covered day (`20260219`) had no saved production quant-signals file at all.

hypothesis: `LLM soft ranking` remains the highest-upside alpha branch, but current replay readiness is still overstated because 'covered candidate day' only means a dated LLM response exists. If covered days are split by whether saved production `quant_signals_YYYYMMDD.json` actually overlaps the backtest pre-LLM candidate set, then the real blocker becomes measurable and we avoid launching ranking experiments on context-mismatched samples.
next_retry_requires: Do not start `LLM soft ranking` while only 1/31 candidate days and 1/44 candidate signals are production-context aligned

Prioritize accumulating or reconstructing aligned prompt/response archives on dates where production `quant_signals` actually contains candidates, instead of counting every dated response file as equal progress
Treat `production_quant_empty` covered days as evidence of context mismatch, not evidence of usable LLM veto sample growth
notes: Covered-day alignment audit on the deterministic primary window: `20260414` was the only aligned date (backtest candidate `CRDO`, production quant candidates `AMZN/GE/UNH/CRDO`); `20260416` and `20260421` had LLM replies but production quant files were empty; `20260219` had a replay file but no saved production quant-signals file. This means the LLM blocker is stricter than the previous 4/31 headline implied.
